notes.title: Exciting Hotel Simulator Update: New Features, Better Control, and Key Fixes!
notes.notes:
Dear Hoteliers,

We’re excited to bring you a new update for Hotel Simulator! This patch focuses on giving you more control, adding new features, and making life as a hotel manager smoother and more enjoyable. Let’s dive into what’s new:

🕒 Longer Days
We’ve increased the length of the in-game day by 30%, giving you more time to manage your hotel and attend to tasks.

🛎️ Enhanced Guest Information
Now, you can see how many days a guest has left before checkout, giving you better insight into your hotel’s operations.

🖱️ Mouse and Button Customization
Expanded mouse settings and the ability to rebind controls mean more flexibility for managing your hotel your way.

🛋️ Furniture Placement
You can now buy furniture and place it anywhere in your hotel! Guests will interact with it - relaxing, sipping coffee, and more, adding life to your hotel’s atmosphere.

☕ New Vending Machines
Install coffee and snack machines around your hotel to keep your guests happy and your spaces lively!

🚗 Vehicle Collision Fixes
We’ve addressed the most common issues with vehicle collisions to ensure smoother parking lot management.

🛎️ Reception Desk Bell Rings Less Frequently
The reception desk bell will now ring less often, giving you a more peaceful front desk experience.

🏢 Checkout in the Morning
Guests now check out during the first half of the day, streamlining room turnover and improving flow.

This update is packed with features and fixes inspired by your feedback. We’re constantly working to improve Hotel Simulator and bring your ideas to life. As always, thank you for your suggestions and support!

Jump back into the game today to experience the changes for yourself, and let us know what you think.
Happy managing,

The Hotel Simulator Team

notes.title: Hotel Business Simulator Releases Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
We are thrilled to announce the latest update for Hotel Business Simulator, our immersive game that lets you build and manage your dream hotel empire. This update is a direct response to the invaluable feedback we have received from our dedicated community. Your insights and suggestions have helped us enhance the game experience by addressing several bugs and making key improvements.
In this update, we have fixed the following issues based on your feedback:

- Extra chambermaids: The problem of new chambermaids returning in double the initially hired quantity after the shift has been resolved.

- Chambermaids stealing linens: The problem of chambermaids taking clean linens “home” with them during unlucky situations, such as when the bus arrives at the hotel and a chambermaid carrying clean linens disappears with them, leaving the beds bare and always dirty, has been resolved.

- Lost linen check: At the beginning of each new day, there is a check for any missing linens, and the beds are automatically made with clean ones.

- Interaction with garbage bags: The problem of large black garbage bags becoming invisible and hindering further gameplay under certain circumstances when held in hand has been resolved. Now, the player character automatically discards the bag when interacting with a computer or a bed.

- Chambermaids boost: Increased movement speed by 5%, sweeping speed by 40%, and garbage collection speed by 20%.

[b]NEW BUG FIX UPDATE:[/b]

- Object and Texture Display Issue: Due to the fact that some objects and textures were displayed incorrectly after saving, our team has fixed this issue to enhance the overall user experience. This fix ensures that all objects and textures are rendered accurately, preventing any visual discrepancies.

- Sleep Transition Effect Adjustment: The blur effect that occurred when falling asleep has been replaced with a darkening effect to avoid unpleasant sensations for players. This change aims to provide a more comfortable and immersive experience during the sleep transition phase.

These improvements are the result of a team effort aimed at refining and optimizing the game for our valued players.

We are committed to continuously improving Hotel Business Simulator and providing our players with the best possible gaming experience. Your feedback plays a crucial role in shaping the future of the game, and we encourage you to keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us.

Thank you once again for being an essential part of the Hotel Business Simulator community. We look forward to your continued support and can’t wait to hear what you think of the latest update!
Stay tuned for more updates and happy hotel building!

Sincerely,
The Hotel Business Simulator Team

notes.title: Hotel Business Simulator and Its Charming Maids Already Released on Steam 😉
notes.notes:
Dear gamers and enthusiasts,

We’re thrilled to announce that the much-awaited “Hotel Business Simulator” has officially hit the shelves of Steam, ready to whisk you away into a world of hospitality, management, and unexpected surprises!

Developed by the creative minds behind two beloved predecessors, this third game promises to elevate your gaming experience to new heights. As you step into the shoes of a hotel manager, you’ll find yourself immersed in the intricate world of hospitality, where every decision shapes the destiny of your establishment.

But what sets “Hotel Business Simulator” apart from its predecessors? Well, aside from the refined gameplay mechanics and stunning visuals, there’s a little secret waiting to be discovered by eager players. Yes, you heard it right – it’s a fan game crafted with love and passion. The developers have hidden something special within the game, a surprise that’ll leave you pleasantly astonished once you uncover it.

So, whether you’re a veteran of the series or a newcomer eager to dive into the world of hotel management, “Hotel Business Simulator” offers an experience like no other.

Don’t miss out on the opportunity to indulge in the ultimate hotel management simulation. Head over to Steam now and make your reservation at “Hotel Business Simulator” – where every detail counts, and every decision matters.

Here’s to happy managing and unforgettable adventures!

Warm regards,
Midnight Games

notes.title: Master the Art of Hospitality: ‘Hotel Business Simulator’ Launching on June 4th
notes.notes:
Derived from extensive player feedback, ‘Hotel Business Simulator’ is crafted to offer an unparalleled gaming experience. With a meticulous attention to detail, players are invited to delve into the captivating realm of hotel empire building. Whether you envision a quaint guesthouse or a lavish resort, the power to shape your destiny lies in your hands. Are you ready to unleash your inner mogul?

Key features of the game include the ability to elevate your establishment through stellar upgrades, personalized room designs catering to the most discerning clientele, and the delicate balance of financial strategy to ensure sustainable growth. With an emphasis on guest satisfaction and impeccable cleanliness, players must navigate the dynamic day-night cycle of hotel management, ensuring every aspect of their establishment operates flawlessly.

Are you prepared to immerse yourself in the challenges of hotel entrepreneurship and conquer the hospitality world? The adventure beckons!

notes.title: Hotel Business Simulator
notes.notes:
Hey There, Hotel Heroes! 🌟
Jump into the exciting world of "Hotel Business Simulator," where you're the brains behind the ultimate hotel empire. Transform a humble spot into the talk of the town, turning a basic bed and breakfast into a luxurious resort. Your choices, your empire!

What's Inside Your Hotel Empire:
- Stars in Your Eyes: Your hotel's success is all about its stars. Upgrade and embellish to go from a modest establishment to a high-end luxury resort.
- Rooms with Personality: Every room is a blank canvas. Will it be minimalist chic or opulent splendor? The more upscale the room, the more upscale the clientele.
- Guests' Delight: Keep those guests grinning from check-in to check-out. Cater to their needs, from the basic to the extravagant, and watch your popularity rise.
- Cash Flow Management: Set your room rates wisely. Balance splendor with cost-effectiveness to maximize those profits.
- Spotless Reputation: Cleanliness is next to godliness in the hotel biz. A clean room is essential for guest satisfaction.
- Understanding Your Guests: Each guest comes with their own set of expectations. Match them with the perfect room to ensure their stay is memorable.
- Day's End: When the sun sets, it’s time for a well-deserved rest. Prepare for the next day of bustling hotel management!

"Hotel Business Simulator" is more than a game; it’s your journey to becoming a hospitality mogul. Are you ready to create, decorate, and run the hotel of your dreams? Let the business begin!
